role.zh: 宇航员多标志物健康监测

team.description: UFlorida 2026 正在开发面向长期航天任务的生物传感平台，利用计算设计的结合蛋白，从小体积生物样本中检测骨钙素、PD-L1 和皮质醇等标志物，分别关注骨健康、免疫功能与应激。团队正在开发和验证结合蛋白设计流程及台式传感平台，目标是以较少耗材获得可重复的检测结果。未来任务中，平台拟向乘员提供可在舱内获取的标志物数据，支持自主健康监测与临床决策，减少对样本返回地面和地面实验室的依赖。
team.description_en: UFlorida 2026 is developing a biosensing platform for long-duration spaceflight, using computationally designed binding proteins to detect biomarkers including osteocalcin, PD-L1 and cortisol from small-volume biological samples, addressing bone health, immune function and stress. The team is developing and validating the binder-design pipeline alongside a benchtop sensing platform, aiming for repeatable measurements with minimal consumables. For future missions, the platform is intended to give crews accessible onboard biomarker data to support autonomous health monitoring and clinical decision-making with less reliance on sample return and Earth-based laboratories.

The binder-design pipeline and benchtop sensing platform are under development and validation, with measurement targets including osteocalcin, PD-L1 and cortisol. The design aims to combine repeatable measurements with low consumable requirements.

nodes.description: PD-L1 与皮质醇是该项目在骨钙素之外关注的检测靶标，分别用于表征免疫功能与应激相关的健康维度。项目围绕这些靶标设计结合蛋白，以扩展长期航天任务中的生物标志物检测范围。
nodes.description_en: PD-L1 and cortisol are detection targets alongside osteocalcin, representing immune-function and stress-related aspects of health. The project develops binding proteins for these targets to extend biomarker sensing during long-duration spaceflight.
